```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(arrow)
library(stargazer)
library(lmtest)
library(data.table)
library(sandwich)
```
  

```{r}
save_path_data <- "C:/Users/DBT3KD/Desktop/Etude_macro_elec/prix_electricite_gitlab/day_ahead/outputs/esp"
setwd(save_path_data)
price_indispo_merge_NTC <- read_parquet("price_indispo_merge_esp_NTC.parquet")
price_indispo_merge_NTC <- price_indispo_merge_NTC %>%
  fill(spot_gas, .direction = "up") %>% 
  rename(renewable_day_ahead_forecast = day_ahead_forecast)



```

```{r}

colnames_with_capacity <- colnames(price_indispo_merge_NTC)[grepl("Capacity", colnames(price_indispo_merge_NTC))]
#get monthly avg of unavailabilities
capacity_fields <- 
  c(colnames_with_capacity,
    "renewable_day_ahead_forecast",  "unpredicted_renewables", "intraday_update_renewables",
    "NTC_FR_ES", "NTC_ES_FR", "NTC_ES_PT", "NTC_PT_ES"  ,"renewable_day_ahead_forecast_ex_es" ,  "cbf_es"

    )
price_indispo_merge_NTC[colnames_with_capacity] <- lapply(price_indispo_merge_NTC[colnames_with_capacity], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), 0, x))
#
price_indispo_merge_NTC <- price_indispo_merge_NTC %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(capacity_fields), 
                ~ . / 1000)) %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity = Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity - Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
              temperature_mismatch = temperature_demand - temperature_supply 
         ) 

price_indispo_merge_NTC <- price_indispo_merge_NTC[complete.cases(price_indispo_merge_NTC),]

price_indispo_merge_NTC <- price_indispo_merge_NTC[!rowSums(sapply(price_indispo_merge_NTC, is.infinite)), ]

price_indispo_merge_NTC$weekday <- weekdays(price_indispo_merge_NTC$delivery_date)
price_indispo_merge_NTC$creneau <- hour(price_indispo_merge_NTC$datetime)


colnames(price_indispo_merge_NTC)  


```

On suggère deux hypothèses, soit différence en niveau sur longue période, soit différence immédiate sur des conditions quasi similaires lors de l'activation d'une indispo à deux créneaux proches.

Attention le fait d'avoir pris des heures arrondies à l'heure plien la plus proche peut fausser
les résultats.


```{r}
# perform first stage regression
m_rf <- lm(
  log(price) ~ Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
     gen_tot+ renewable_day_ahead_forecast   + spot_gas+
    unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables+
    temperature_supply + temperature_mismatch +
    precipitation_demand + precipitation_supply +
    relative_humidity_demand + relative_humidity_supply
    ,
  data= price_indispo_merge_NTC)


vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
cl_se_rf <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# # Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
# vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# # Erreurs standard clusterisées
# cl_se <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
# rf_names <- names(coefficients(m_log_control))[grep("Predicted", names(coefficients(m_log_control)))]
# cl_se_rf[rf_names] <- cl_se[rf_names]


m_rf_FE <- lm(
  log(price) ~  Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity+  
    Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity + 
    Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity +
    gen_tot+ renewable_day_ahead_forecast   + spot_gas + 
    unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables+
    temperature_supply + temperature_mismatch +
    precipitation_demand + precipitation_supply +
    relative_humidity_demand + relative_humidity_supply+
    as.factor(year) + as.factor(month) + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data= price_indispo_merge_NTC)
# Matrice de variance-covariance clusterisée
vcov_cluster <- vcovCL(m_rf_FE , type = "HC0", cluster = ~ cl_rf_id)
# Erreurs standard clusterisées
cl_se_rf_FE <- sqrt(diag(vcov_cluster))
```




```{r, results = 'asis'}


reg_table <- stargazer(  m_rf, m_rf_FE,  
    type = "html",
    se = list( cl_se_rf, cl_se_rf_FE),
    title = "Regression Results",
    column.labels = c(  "XGB", "XGB + Time FE"),
    keep = c("Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity" , "Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
             "Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "Uneffective.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity",
              "Planned.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity", "Planned.Limiting.Capacity",
    "Published.Limiting.Capacity", "Unpublished.Limiting.Capacity", "UnPublished.Limiting.Capacity",
      "gen_tot",
             "renewable_day_ahead_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables",
    "temperature_mismatch", "temperature_supply",
    "precipitation_supply", "precipitation_demand",
    "relative_humidity_supply", "relative_humidity_demand")
)
 
```





NTC have predictive powers inasmuch as constrain the transmission of cheap electricity from abroad

```{r}
colnames(price_indispo_merge_NTC)
m_ntc <- lm(
  log(price) ~ NTC_FR_ES + NTC_ES_FR + 
    gen_tot+ renewable_day_ahead_forecast   + spot_gas,
  data= price_indispo_merge_NTC)


m_ntc_FE <- lm(
  log(price) ~ NTC_FR_ES + NTC_ES_FR +
    gen_tot+ renewable_day_ahead_forecast   +
    spot_gas + unpredicted_renewables + intraday_update_renewables + 
    + as.factor(weekday) + as.factor(creneau),
  data= price_indispo_merge_NTC)

```


```{r}

stargazer(m_ntc, m_ntc_FE, 
          type = "text", 
          title = "Regression Results",
          column.labels = c("Basic", "Time FE"),
          keep = c("NTC_FR_ESP", "NTC_ESP_FR", "gen_tot",
                   "renewable_day_ahead_forecast", "spot_gas", "unpredicted_renewables","unpredicted_renewables_sq", "intraday_update_renewables")
          )

```
